title: playbook (version 2)
description: Where we are, what can happen, and what is true while it does. DECISIONS are the state space; EVENTS are what can happen, each showing ONE document written in the book. The walk over it is session-only: nothing is written back.

version.description: 2 — every document written in the file, the walk session-only.

decisions.description: The state space — questions, each with its answers.

events.description: What can happen, and the one document each shows when taken.

x-studio-refused: At version 2: `rules`, `topics` and `view` at the top; `status`, `sets`, a `content` list or a `file` entry on an event.

decision.description: A question, with its answers. A state is the set of answers taken; none is ever written.

key.description: Identity — appears in every `when` and `docs` key.
Identity of the answer; a ref is `decision=answer`.

activates.description: Decisions that exist only while this answer is taken.

items.description: A ref `decision=answer` — the decision's key, `=`, the answer's key.

when.description: The answer is on offer only while every ref holds.

label.description: The event as shown in the rail.

trigger.description: `imposed` arrives whether or not we are ready (default); `chosen` fires when we say so.

arity.description: `once` (default) is a move; `many` never leaves the table.

rate.description: How often a `many` event fires, such as `5/w`.

domain.description: A grouping heading in the rail.

detail.description: One italic line shown when the event is open.

items.description: A ref `decision=answer` — the decision's key, `=`, the answer's key.

when.description: The event is on the table only while every ref holds; absent, always.

hint.description: Markdown shown while an answer the document follows is still open, or as the whole detail when the event has no document.

content.description: The one document the event shows — a mapping, not a list. `kind` names the renderer; then either `doc`, one document as that kind's YAML parses it (a string for `md`), or `by` + `docs`, a closed set of them — one per combination of the `by` answers, keyed `decision=answer,...` in `by` order.

key.description: A stable name for the entry: what the view collapses by.

kind.description: The kind of the document, or of every member of `docs`.

doc.description: One document, as its kind's YAML parses it; a string for `md`.

by.description: The decisions the set is keyed by, in key order.

docs.description: One document per combination of the `by` answers, keyed `decision=answer,...` in `by` order — no more and no less.

content.x-studio-closed-set: The keys of `docs` are exactly the answer combinations of `by`.
